reason: The global DSH CLI was 0.2.0-rc.2. Its profile loader skipped huiyi-rag-parity-eval because the plugin peer range pins dsh-tools 0.2.1-alpha.1. DSH therefore exposed only default web_search tools; no research_medical_question tool was registered.
resolution: Use the local dsh-runtime entry with version 0.2.1-alpha.1. Its read-only config dump confirms huiyi-rag-parity-eval is included with no skipped-bundle warning.
